channel.title: Bargain Hunt
channel.desc: The show is in Staffordshire, home of the world-renowned Potteries. Christina Trevanion meets a man with more than 1,200 Staffordshire figures, which he stores in a specially built room on the side of his house! Meanwhile, two teams go hunting for antiques at Bingley Hall in the company of their experts, Izzie Balmer and Nick Hall. In the red jackets are married couple Agnes and Irfan, and in blue are colleagues Lorraine and Hannah.
